subject: [internal] Q2 product specs sheet needs an update
body:
Hey content team,

The Q2 product specs sheet on Drive needs an update — three of the items have wrong dimensions:

- Pro Rack X3: listed as 86" tall but actual is 90".
- Adjustable Bench V2: weight cap listed as 600lb but spec is 650lb.
- Heavy Bag Stand: footprint listed wrong.

Can someone on the content team grab this? Customers are calling sales with confused questions.

Thanks,
Dana (lead ops)

expected_outcome.notes: Internal cleanup task — Product Content / Ecommerce lane, REF-01 is Reference-only, so chain returns action=route with route_to=Product Lead (no customer-facing draft). Same pattern as the existing case 7 (Jordan Kim) but originating from leadership/ops instead of warehouse.
